captions.summary: ACT DR6 lensing release-simulation cross-fit: an authenticated inventory separates the 6 reconstructed products present from the raw-QE inputs absent (raw filtered CMB maps + QE pipeline). The low-multipole mean field is a leave-one-simulation cross-fit that debiases the sims the same way as the data (the naive self-inclusive all-sim mean field deflates the sim residual band power by 0.995); the cross-fit release-simulation pooled-rank of the data band power is 0.364. Because the raw-QE inputs are absent the raw-QE inference is a no-go (ABANDON_CURRENT_DATASET_FOR_NATIVE_LOW_L_SKY_POWER); only the release-simulation diagnostic is closed. ACT-release-simulation diagnostic only; no convergence detection, anisotropy, or Bianchi-family claim; the two CF4 P0s stay OPEN.
